topic: Migrating demographic calculations to unique area IDs
summary_markdown:
The discussion focused on migrating the demographic calculation logic from using old area IDs (based on country and code) to a more robust system utilizing unique, facility-specific area numbers (`demographic_area_num`).

Currently, calculations rely on views that use two keys: `country` + `area_code`. The proposed solution involves implementing changes in the aggregation view (`recalc_demography_area`) to switch from old IDs to the unique `demographic_area_num`, which can be retrieved using a dedicated dictionary or temporary view.

The primary challenge is updating the core aggregation script (e.g., `agg_demography_area.sql`), as this requires careful handling of naming conventions and potentially recalculating historical data, although it was noted that site-side reporting already uses facility-level aggregation (`device_demography_agg_filtered`).

The consensus is to proceed with the implementation in the aggregation layer.
decisions: Implement changes to the core aggregation view (`recalc_demography_area`) to use unique area numbers instead of old IDs.
action_items: [p1] will create a task for the implementation, which [me] agreed to take on when time permits.
